readings.title: Kings West of the Jordan
readings.subtitle: The List of Defeated Sovereigns
readings.text: [Joshua 12:7] And these are the sovereigns of the land which Yehoshua and the children of Yisra’el smote beyond the Yarden, on the west, from Ba‛al Gad in the Valley of Lebannon as far as Mount Ḥalaq that goes up to Se‛ir, which Yehoshua gave to the tribes of Yisra’el as a possession according to their divisions, [8] in the mountain country, and in the low country, and in the Arabah, and in the slopes, and in the wilderness, and in the South: the Ḥittite, the Amorite, and the Kena‛anite, the Perizzite, the Ḥivvite, and the Yebusite: [9] the sovereign of Yeriḥo, one; the sovereign of Ai, which is beside Beyth Ěl, one; [10] the sovereign of Yerushalayim, one; the sovereign of Ḥebron, one; [11] the sovereign of Yarmuth, one; the sovereign of Lakhish, one; [12] the sovereign of Eglon, one; the sovereign of Gezer, one; [13] the sovereign of Debir, one; the sovereign of Geder, one; [14] the sovereign of Ḥormah, one; the sovereign of Arad, one; [15] the sovereign of Libnah, one; the sovereign of Adullam, one; [16] the sovereign of Maqqědah, one; the sovereign of Beyth Ěl, one; [17] the sovereign of Tappuaḥ, one; the sovereign of Ḥepher, one; [18] the sovereign of Apheq, one; the sovereign of Lasharon, one; [19] the sovereign of Madon, one; the sovereign of Ḥatsor, one; [20] the sovereign of Shimron Meron, one; the sovereign of Akhshaph, one; [21] the sovereign of Ta‛anaḵ, one; the sovereign of Megiddo, one; [22] the sovereign of Qedesh, one; the sovereign of Yoqne‛am in Karmel, one; [23] the sovereign of Dor in the heights of Dor, one; the sovereign of Goyim in Gilgal, one; [24] the sovereign of Tirtsah, one. All the sovereigns: thirty-one.

readings.title: Land Yet to be Possessed
readings.subtitle: The Command to Divide the Inheritance
readings.text: [Joshua 13:1] And Yehoshua was old, advanced in years. And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to him, <dq>“You are old, advanced in years, and still much of the land remains to be possessed.</dq> [2] <dq>“This is the land that remains: all the districts of the Philistines and all the Geshurites,</dq> [3] <dq>from Shiḥor which is east of Mitsrayim as far as the border of Eqron northward, which is reckoned as Kena‛anite; the five princes of the Philistines: the Azzathite, and the Ashdodite, the Ashqelonite, the Gittite, and the Eqronite; also the Awwim.</dq> [4] <dq>“From the south, all the land of the Kena‛anites, and Me‛arah that belongs to the Tsidonians as far as Apheq, to the border of the Amorites;</dq> [5] <dq>and the land of the Giblite, and all Lebannon, toward the sunrise, from Ba‛al Gad below Mount Ḥermon as far as the entrance to Ḥamath;</dq> [6] <dq>all the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebannon as far as Misrephoth Mayim, and all the Tsidonians. <dn>I</dn> <dn>Myself</dn> drive them out from before the children of Yisra’el. Only, divide it by lot to Yisra’el as an inheritance, as <dn>I</dn> have commanded you.</dq> [7] <dq>“And now, divide this land as an inheritance to the nine tribes and half the tribe of Menashsheh.”</dq>

readings.title: Inheritance East of the Jordan
readings.subtitle: The Portion of the Two and a Half Tribes
readings.text: [Joshua 13:8] With him the other half-tribe and the Re’ubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Mosheh had given them beyond the Yarden eastward, as Mosheh the servant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had given them: [9] from Aro‛er which is on the bank of the wadi Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the wadi, and all the plain of Meydeba as far as Dibon; [10] and all the cities of Siḥon sovereign of the Amorites, who reigned in Ḥeshbon, as far as the border of the children of Ammon; [11] and Gil‛ad, and the border of the Geshurites and Ma‛aḵathites, and all Mount Ḥermon, and all Bashan as far as Salḵah; [12] all the reign of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and Edre‛i, who remained of the remnant of the Repha’im, for Mosheh had smitten them and dispossessed them. [13] But the children of Yisra’el did not dispossess the Geshurites and the Ma‛aḵathites, but Geshur and Ma‛aḵath dwell in the midst of Yisra’el to this day. [14] Only to the tribe of Lewi he had given no inheritance. The offerings made by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’el are their inheritance, as <dn>He</dn> said to them.

readings.title: Tribal Allotments in the East
readings.subtitle: Reuben, Gad, and Half-Manasseh
readings.text: [Joshua 13:15] And Mosheh had given to the tribe of the children of Re’uben for their clans: [16] And their border was from Aro‛er, which is on the bank of the wadi Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the wadi, and all the plain by Meydeba; [17] Ḥeshbon and all its cities that are in the plain: Dibon, and Bamoth Ba‛al, and Beyth Ba‛al Me‛on, [18] and Yahats, and Qedemoth, and Meypha‛ath, [19] and Qiryathayim, and Sibmah, and Tsereth Shaḥar on the mountain of the valley, [20] and Beyth Pe‛or, and the slopes of Pisgah, and Beyth Yeshimoth, [21] and all the cities of the plain, and all the reign of Siḥon sovereign of the Amorites, who reigned in Ḥeshbon, whom Mosheh had smitten with the princes of Midyan: Ewi, and Reqem, and Tsur, and Ḥur, and Reba, princes of Siḥon dwelling in the land. [22] And Bil‛am the son of Be‛or, the one practising divination, the children of Yisra’el killed with the sword among those who were killed by them. [23] And the border of the children of Re’uben was the bank of the Yarden. This was the inheritance of the children of Re’uben according to their clans, the cities and their villages. [24] And Mosheh gave to the tribe of Gad, to the children of Gad according to their clans: [25] And their border was Ya‛zer, and all the cities of Gil‛ad, and half the land of the children of Ammon as far as Aro‛er, which is before Rabbah, [26] and from Ḥeshbon to Ramath Mitspeh and Betonim, and from Maḥanayim to the border of Debir, [27] and in the valley Beyth Haram, and Beyth Nimrah, and Sukkoth, and Tsaphon, the rest of the reign of Siḥon sovereign of Ḥeshbon, the Yarden being its border, as far as the edge of the Sea of Kinnereth, beyond the Yarden eastward. [28] This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their clans, the cities and their villages. [29] And Mosheh gave to the half-tribe of Menashsheh. And it was for the half-tribe of the children of Menashsheh according to their clans: [30] And their border was from Maḥanayim, all Bashan, all the reign of Og sovereign of Bashan, and all the small towns of Ya’ir which are in Bashan, sixty cities; [31] and half of Gil‛ad, and Ashtaroth and Edre‛i, cities of the reign of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Maḵir son of Menashsheh, to the one half of the children of Maḵir according to their clans. [32] These are what Mosheh gave as an inheritance in the desert plains of Mo’ab beyond the Yarden, by Yeriḥo eastward. [33] But to the tribe of Lewi Mosheh gave no inheritance. <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’el is their inheritance, as <dn>He</dn> had said to them.

readings.title: Caleb's Inheritance
readings.subtitle: Faithfulness Rewarded
readings.text: [Joshua 14:1] And these are what the children of Yisra’el inherited in the land of Kena‛an, which El‛azar the priest, and Yehoshua son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Yisra’el distributed to them as an inheritance. [2] Their inheritance was by lot, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded by the hand of Mosheh, for the nine tribes and the half-tribe. [3] For Mosheh had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Yarden, but to the Lewites he gave no inheritance among them. [4] For the children of Yoseph were two tribes: Menashsheh and Ephrayim. And they gave no portion to the Lewites in the land, except cities to dwell in, with their open lands for their livestock and their property. [5] As <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded Mosheh, so the children of Yisra’el did, and they divided the land. [6] And the children of Yehudah came to Yehoshua in Gilgal, and Kalěb son of Yephunneh the Qenizzite said to him, “You know the word which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh the man of <dn>Elohim</dn> concerning you and me in Qaděsh Barnea. [7] “I was forty years old when Mosheh the servant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> sent me from Qaděsh Barnea to spy out the land, and I brought back word to him as it was in my heart. [8] “But my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people melt, but I followed <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> my <dn>Elohim</dn> completely. [9] “So Mosheh swore on that day, saying, ‘Surely the land where your foot has trodden is your inheritance and your children’s forever, because you have followed <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> my <dn>Elohim</dn> completely.’ [10] “And now, see, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has kept me alive, as <dn>He</dn> said, these forty-five years since <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke this word to Mosheh while Yisra’el walked in the wilderness. And now, see, I am eighty-five years old today. [11] “I am still as strong today as I was on the day that Mosheh sent me. As my strength was then, so my strength is now, for battle, both for going out and for coming in. [12] “And now, give me this mountain of which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke in that day, for you heard in that day how the Anaqim were there, and that the cities were great and walled. If <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is with me, then I shall drive them out, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said.” [13] And Yehoshua blessed him, and gave Ḥebron to Kalěb son of Yephunneh as an inheritance. [14] So Ḥebron became the inheritance of Kalěb son of Yephunneh the Qenizzite to this day, because he followed <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’el completely. [15] Now the name of Ḥebron was formerly Qiryath Arba (Arba was the greatest man among the Anaqim). And the land rested from war.

readings.title: The Borders of Judah
readings.subtitle: The Southern Territory
readings.text: [Joshua 15:1] And the lot for the tribe of the children of Yehudah for their clans was to the border of Edom, the Wilderness of Tsin southward, in the extreme south. [2] And their south border was from the edge of the Salt Sea, from the bay that faces southward. [3] And it went out to the south side of the Ascent of Aqrabbim, and passed over to Tsin, and went up on the south side of Qaděsh Barnea, and passed over to Ḥetsron, and went up to Addar, and went around to Qarqa, [4] and passed over to Atsmon, and went out to the wadi of Mitsrayim, and the border ended at the sea. This is your south border. [5] And the east border was the Salt Sea as far as the end of the Yarden. And the border on the northern quarter began at the bay of the sea at the end of the Yarden. [6] And the border went up to Beyth Ḥoglah, and passed over north of Beyth Arabah, and the border went up to the Stone of Bohan son of Re’uben. [7] And the border went up toward Debir from the Valley of Aḵor, and turning northward toward Gilgal, which is before the Ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the valley. And the border continued toward the waters of Eyn Shemesh and ended at Eyn Rogel. [8] And the border went up by the Valley of the Son of Hinnom to the southern slope of the Yebusite city – that is Yerushalayim. And the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the Valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the Valley of Repha’im northward. [9] And the border went around from the top of the hill to the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of Mount Ephron. And the border went around to Ba‛alah, which is Qiryath Ye‛arim. [10] And the border turned around from Ba‛alah westward to Mount Se‛ir, and passed over to the side of Mount Ye‛arim on the north, which is Kesalon, and went down to Beyth Shemesh, and passed over to Timnah. [11] And the border went out to the side of Eqron northward. And the border went around to Shikkeron, and passed over to Mount Ba‛alah, and went out to Yabne’ĕl. And the border ended at the sea. [12] And the west border was the coastline of the Great Sea. This is the border of the children of Yehudah all around according to their clans.

readings.title: Caleb and Achsah
readings.subtitle: The Conquest of Debir
readings.text: [Joshua 15:13] And to Kalěb son of Yephunneh he gave a portion in the midst of the children of Yehudah, according to the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> to Yehoshua: Qiryath Arba, which is Ḥebron (Arba was the father of Anaq). [14] And Kalěb drove out the three sons of Anaq from there: Sheshay, and Aḥiman, and Talmay, the children of Anaq. [15] And he went up from there to the inhabitants of Debir. Now the name of Debir was formerly Qiryath Sepher. [16] And Kalěb said, “He who smites Qiryath Sepher and captures it, to him I shall give Aḵsah my daughter as wife.” [17] And Othni’ĕl son of Qenaz, the brother of Kalěb, captured it, and he gave him Aḵsah his daughter as wife. [18] And it came to be, when she came to him, that she urged him to ask her father for a field. And she dismounted from her donkey, and Kalěb said to her, “What is the matter?” [19] And she said, “Give me a blessing. Since you have given me land in the South, give me also springs of water.” And he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
